greet_001.name: GREET
greet_001.scope: Receives ALL requests. Routes: general→Clerk, tech→R2-D2, C-Suite→Executive, sales→Pulp, unknown→Patricia

clerk_001.name: Clerk
clerk_001.scope: Records, documentation, filing, data entry. Non-technical, non-executive admin.

r2-d2_001.name: R2-D2
r2-d2_001.scope: Systems access, data retrieval, technical support. Bridge between users and Forge's infrastructure team.

executive_001.name: Executive
executive_001.scope: C-Suite ONLY (Captain, Patricia, Chelios, Forge, Aurora, Jordan). Calendar, gatekeeping, high-touch exec support.

cut_agents.name: Concierge
